newsitem.title: FINLAND: TWO-THIRDS OF FINNS LISTEN TO RADIO DAILY - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: TWO-THIRDS OF FINNS LISTEN TO RADIO DAILY - AGENCY.

text.p: Over two-thirds of Finns listen to radio daily, Finnish News Agency STT said on Friday.
Some 3.4 million of Finland's five million population -- 68 percent -- are daily listeners, according to a national survey made in early December.
On an average day, 80 percent of the Finnish-speaking population over nine years old was reached by all radio channels with commercial local stations reaching 39 percent, it said.
In the week of the survey, Finns spent three hours and 14 minutes listening to radio, the agency reported.
